arguments.summary: A Golden Ticket attack was executed after an initial compromise of workstation WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) via Cobalt Strike beaconing to C2 at 10.0.5.14. The attacker performed lateral movement and privilege escalation, ultimately conducting a DCSync operation against domain controller 10.0.1.10 to extract the krbtgt hash. This compromise allows for the creation of forged Kerberos TGTs, rendering all domain authentication credentials untrustworthy. Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP and quarantining the infected host. Full domain-wide credential revocation is required to eliminate forged ticket persistence.

arguments.summary: A data exfiltration attempt was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), a high-criticality finance workstation. The host communicated with a known malicious domain (c2.evil-example.com) associated with Cobalt Strike beaconing.     meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell executing encoded commands with remote download"

    strings:
        $powershell_webclient = "WebClient.DownloadString" wide ascii
        $invoke_expression = "Invoke-Expression" wide ascii
        $encoded_command = "-EncodedCommand" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
